name: Variant: market-clearing wages
description: The same AI, with wages that absorb excess supply at the top of the elasticity range: wage adjustment toward the wage-curve target at the top of its range (P.73 = 0.6 per quarter), productivity pass-through to wages at the top of its range (P.74 = 0.6), reinstatement of displaced work in new tasks at the top of its range (P.61 = 0.8) and the output demand response to lower costs at the top of the P.60 range (scale 1.5). Read beside the baseline for the wage effect and the under-25 share of jobs lost (review §2.7).
